history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration develop indicators to measure the processing times for contributions.
history.administration_response: Implemented. With the deployment of the Umoja grants module, all the voluntary contributions have a clear audit trail to keep track of dates of each donor agreement signed by both parties, billing date, billing due date and deposit receipt date. Furthermore, the bank statements are monitored daily to ensure timely application of incoming deposits against outstanding voluntary receivables.
history.board_assessment: The Board noted the response of the Administration and considers this recommendation as implemented.
